title: Add one reproducible evaluation ablation
objective: Implement a bounded evaluation ablation and report results without changing the frozen baseline.

acceptance.description: A fixed-seed evaluation command is covered by tests.
acceptance.evidence: The registered unit check passes and the report records the exact command and seed.

acceptance.description: The report distinguishes observed, negative, and inconclusive outcomes.
acceptance.evidence: Human review of reports/EXP-001.md against the recorded dataset and metric definitions.

non_goals: Do not retrain the baseline or change its outputs.
Do not upload datasets or large checkpoints.
stop_conditions: The experiment requires an unapproved GPU job or broader scope.

research.hypothesis: Removing the selected component may change the evaluation metric; the direction is not assumed.
